baseline.scope: Current desktop prepared workshop, identical seed/start, native InputEventKey delivery; steady 1.5–4.4 seconds. No model/control modifications.

host_baseline.input: Synthetic OS X11 events, actual desktop workshop scene and current model/control files

gait.definitions: Steady window 1.5–4.4 s. Body origins are forced CUSTOM/zero inertial COM by the existing engine. Whole-body COM excludes the ball. Support offset is relative to supporting ankle centers, NOT contact polygon or center of pressure. Contacts are median-filtered across 3 frames (60 ms). Footfall/stride sample counts are small. Landing velocity change is a kinematic diagnostic, NOT force attribution. No claim that short contact loss establishes a running gait.

continuous_engine_keys.input: Godot InputEventKey in the actual desktop workshop. X11 separate runs passed; an additional continuous X11 attempt was stopped after the owned window lost focus, so it is not counted as passed.

code_change: Read-only 0.4 simulation-second displacement speed shown for MD; reset clears its history; trace records measured speed.
prototype_decision: Reject command-only 0.45 candidate; retain current model/control. Do not artificially slow backward/ordinary to claim forward-running improvement.

resources.scope: Only this round ownership checked for cleanup. Other applications are inventoried, never killed.

closeout.accounting_boundary: Work through verified code push and cleanup. Final commit/push of this sealing record follows this timestamp.
